== Trivia ==
* Named after [[Kevin Millard]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive_2&oldid=447273#Edielh_Shockhunter source]).
* Kemil drops a [[Domination Magic]] unique item even though he does not use Domination skills.
*Despite being a Quetzal boss, Kemil doesn't resemble a [[Quetzal Sly]]. In fact, his skin is that of a [[Sensali Tengu]].
